name: DKG arXiv Autoresearch & LLM-Wiki Ingestor
description: Ingests arXiv papers into DKG v10 Working Memory as W3C PROV-O JSON-LD assertions with SHA-256 source digests, promotes corroborated claims into Shared Working Memory within a bound Context Graph, and runs grounded SPARQL retrieval for LLM-Wiki agents.

install.oneLiner: Clone https://github.com/xaductrung-rgb/dkg-arxiv-autoresearch (Node >=22, zero external dependencies), set DKG_API_URL and DKG_AUTH_TOKEN for your local DKG v10 node, and run `node ./bin/cli.mjs ingest <arxivId>` followed by `node ./bin/cli.mjs promote <assertionName>`.

networkEgress: export.arxiv.org (HTTPS GET /api/query): read-only public arXiv Atom API to fetch paper metadata and abstracts. No telemetry.
writeAuthority: POST /api/assertion/{name}/promote (Shared Working Memory promotion within the bound Context Graph)
security.notes: Talks only to the public read-only arXiv metadata API (export.arxiv.org) and the local DKG v10 node HTTP API on DKG_API_URL. Writes candidate literature assertions to Working Memory (WM) and promotes corroborated assertions to Shared Working Memory (SWM) on explicit operator/agent command (`promote`). Never calls Verifiable Memory publish/endorse/verify operations. Pure Node >=22 ESM package with zero npm dependencies and no preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.

promotionPath: Raw arXiv metadata and extracted atomic claims (schema:Claim) are first written as a W3C PROV-O Bundle into private Working Memory (POST /api/assertion/create + POST /api/assertion/{name}/write) with a deterministic SHA-256 source digest (dkg:sourceDigestSha256). Once corroborated across multiple papers or verified by a research agent, the assertion is promoted to Shared Working Memory (POST /api/assertion/{name}/promote) in the bound Context Graph. Because every SWM assertion preserves explicit prov:wasDerivedFrom links to urn:dkg:autoresearch:paper:<arxivId> and deterministic content hashes, downstream Curators and context oracles can promote matured literature clusters directly into Verified Memory (VM) Knowledge Assets without re-parsing unstructured text.
fitNotes: Directly targets the LLM-Wiki / autoresearch direction (Section 9, criterion 1) by turning scientific literature streams into provenance-grounded Working and Shared Working Memory graphs that prevent unverified hallucination pollution in collaborative agent wikis.
